# name`, written by `kernel-quality miri-times` from a measuring run's nextest report, never by
# hand. A state is the seconds Miri takes to finish the test, always under the 600 s budget; or
# `native-only over N`, a measuring run stopped it after N s with no verdict; or `native-only N`,
